headline: European Shares Slip From Record Highs as Tech Plunges on AI Regulation Fears
summary: Europe's STOXX 600 retreated from all-time highs as technology stocks fell following investor concerns over AI regulation and the implications of the US Democratic congressional sweep.
why: Cross-border market spillovers frequently transmit US technology sell-offs and regulatory concerns to European equity exchanges.

impacts.name: STOXX 600
impacts.why: Broad regional selling in technology stocks pulled the benchmark index lower from record levels.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global technology sector weakness and regulatory anxieties triggered profit-taking across European equity markets.
